Problem: Key cites avoiding labetalol due to 'unopposed alpha-adrenergic stimulation' from beta-blockers in cocaine toxicity. Contemporary toxicology and 2023/2024 AHA/ACC guidelines recognize combined alpha/beta antagonists (labetalol) and pure beta-blockers as viable for severe hyperadrenergic states after benzodiazepines, making labetalol an outdated distractor rationale.
Suggested fix: Rephrase distractor C to a clearly contraindicated pure beta-blocker: 'Administer propranolol'. Update rationale to specify non-selective pure beta-blockade without alpha-antagonist properties.
Evidence (source: American Heart Association (AHA) / American College of Cardiology (ACC). (2023). AHA Scientific Statement on Cardiovascular Emergencies in Substance Use Disorders. https://www.ahajournals.org
